name: Onahole no Naho-chan
original_name: オナホールのなほちゃん
source:
An orphan named Naho-chan is approached by a man.
"I have your mother's last will and testament."
When Naho-chan checks the video of the will at the man's house, she sees her mother being interrogated...
After being subjected to intense interrogation, her mother says,

"I will offer my child that is yet to be born as a sex toy."
